breakdown.reason: The generated specification uses only one consistent sign convention throughout: positive shear V is upward on the left cut face and positive bending moment M causes sagging (tension at the bottom fibers). It does not repeat or include the contradictory redefinition (downward shear on left cut face and hogging as positive) that appeared in the incomplete prompt. This matches the ground truth prompt's single, consistent sign convention.
